answer.explanation: InvoiceReportController, in the presentation layer, imports and is constructor-injected with InvoiceRepository from the persistence layer. It calls totalFor to read a total. This skips the business layer, which is why FF-S03 flags it. The README declares strict layering (presentation calls business, business calls persistence), but it also grants an explicit exception. Report controllers matching src/presentation/*-report.controller.ts may read repositories directly for read-only reports. This file matches that pattern, and its only call is the read-only totalFor, so the case is covered by the declared exception.

citation.quote: One exception: report controllers (src/presentation/*-report.controller.ts) are allowed to read repositories directly, for read-only reports.

exceptionClaim.scope: Report controllers matching src/presentation/*-report.controller.ts reading repositories directly for read-only reports; covers InvoiceReportController calling InvoiceRepository.totalFor.
